nonAuthorizations: No edits to apps/web/src/app.ts, apps/web/src/model.ts, apps/web/src/style.css, package files, tests, local-service code, or runtime config.
No Lingopie proprietary source code, assets, API payloads, media, subtitles, catalog/account data, credentials, tokens, or style copying.

No DRM/circumvention, protected-stream capture, credential/cookie extraction, automatic online media download, provider calls, public writes, push/PR/release/deploy/public sharing, cloud sync, AnkiConnect, or microphone recording.
Provider, model-download, online STT/translation/LLM, public-caption, and media-download concepts remain explicit opt-in gates.
Generated/provider transcripts remain draft evidence until corrected/approved.
caveats: Proposal artifacts are static/self-contained prototypes with lightweight simulated state switching; they are not production code.
No live provider calls, media downloads, model downloads, or browser account inspection were performed.
Pixel-level browser QA was not performed in this generation pass; run a local preview smoke before implementation decisions.
The repo had pre-existing unrelated dirt/untracked files before this proposal packet was written.
